user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawl content for ChatGPT search answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.opt_out: Only visits pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content used in training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests from ChatGPT or Custom GPTs.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for model development and safety enhancement.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content directed by Claude user queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Content analyzed specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image presentations.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for Google Search.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible content for research and development.
user_agents.scope: One-off crawls for internal research and development across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized crawler for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Image fetching for internal research and development across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized crawler for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Video fetching for internal research and development across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents building crawls requested by site owners.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content use for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Apple products and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General web search crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines data usage of crawled content.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content of an app or website shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Content from apps or websites shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, citations, and links in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for foundation AI model training and direct product indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch user-requested links and support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for Amazon product improvements and AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt or noarchive and noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Eligible web content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetch live web information to answer user-initiated queries and actions.
user_agents.scope: Live information retrieval on behalf of users; does not crawl for generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open crawl data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset and sample of the public web.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or use opt-out registry.
